annotations.title: Filtered search over assets, owners, agents (25 rows)

description:
Filtered search over properties, buildings, land, listings, owners
    (companies and overseas entities) or agencies. Returns at most 25 rows a
    page and the total the register states ("how many 3-bed homes in Hackney").
    `criteria` maps refinement names (see search_capabilities) to a value, a list
    or {min, max}; at most 12, short scalars only.

    Do NOT use it to value or appraise anything, to read SQL, GraphQL or free
    text (resolve_place first), or to list land for development (use find_land).
    Owners need a signed-in account and are companies only: a row has
    owner_class and, for companies, name and company number, never a person.
    Free.

    Every UPRN row carries `identity` (unit | building | street | unresolved):
    anything but `unit` may describe a block, so say so; a UPRN with many adverts is not one home.
    Land rows carry no local-plan allocation (none are held). `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry} (point + radius_m up to 2000, bbox up to 5 km, polygon up to 200 vertices); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: 25 rows per page; more via `next_cursor` (use it, do not repeat the query); a page is cut to 8 KB.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.
